$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Catalogue list

band.rule: Takes the band of the service that uses it; commitment state inside it is band 2.

job: Every item of one category, as a grid or a list, with the running selection always in reach.
useFor: One flat list of one kind of item — the items of a category, a collection or a brand — reached from the landing or a themed row’s arrow, for comparing by photo and price (grid) or by longer names and detail (list).
notFor: A typed query (use Search results, which adds the query, the filters and a no-results state); a list that mixes kinds such as items with articles or services (use a landing with rows); a category that would hold only 1 or 2 items (show them in a landing row instead of a near-empty page); a person in a sacred window, where the page is suppressed with the rest of the service.

allowed: Toolbar · Secondary Pages / Default, with the view toggle opposite the back button: grid first, list second, the active view carrying the highlight and remembered for the next category.
forbidden: A title that is not exactly the landing tile’s name.

allowed: The cards-slider pattern in grid layout, or cards-list in list layout: Media Cards · Marketplace / Grid, 189 × 248, 2 per row, or Marketplace / List, 386 × 210, 1 per row.
One card type per view and the same order in both views; the type pill is hidden because the page title already names the category.
forbidden: Mixed card types in one view.
A different sequence between grid and list.
The action made by hiding layers instead of the card’s own status.

allowed: Price Options → Add to Cart CTA · Status cart, one, arrow or Notify me.
Add puts one in the cart without leaving the page, and the stepper then replaces the button; an item with options shows the arrow and opens item details.
forbidden: An out-of-stock item that loses its price.
A stepper that overflows the card.

allowed: Tab Bar · Floating Cart, present on every catalogue page; empty it shows the label and 0.00, with items it shows thumbnails, the count and the total.
forbidden: A hand-drawn cart bar in place of the library component.

rules: Out of stock is stated on the card before the tap, never discovered at checkout.
No "only N left" on cards; a stock count belongs to item details, and only when it is true.
Notify me sends one notification when the item returns, and nothing else.
The default sequence is the catalogue’s own; a paid position is labelled as an ad.

A two-line name must not push the price out of the card, and the price is never truncated; the two view-toggle buttons carry spoken labels and the selected state is exposed to screen readers, not shown by the highlight alone.

allocation.Withheld: For Dependents and Organised groups the add and pay controls are withheld (P0); cards stay readable, the action is not shown.

measure.success: Adds per listing view, share of sessions that add 2 items or more, listing to item-page rate
measure.guardrails: removals right after an add (accidental adds), Notify me requests that never receive a notification, complaints per 1,000 requests

allocation.Inherits: Marketplace: DNA Supportive · band 6 · interrupts for offers are T3 · suppressed in sacred windows.
allocation.App level: L3 · inside the Marketplace. Reached from a category tile, a row arrow or a deep link; not a destination from Home.

example.inTheFlowToday: The view toggle is hand-built inside the toolbar: two actions hidden, one shown, two icons swapped with layer overrides; it needs a toolbar type of its own. The type pill is hidden with a layer override on every card; Media Cards needs a property for it. The in-cart stepper overflows a 189 card at library defaults, corrected here with layout overrides repeated from the flow; the fix belongs in Price Options. List cards in the flow still use the earlier card structure; the library now uses Price Options, and this template follows the library. Every card shows a "starting from" label, including items with one price. The empty-state title in the flow is misspelled and the body has a double space; both are corrected here, though the state still offers no next step. The empty screen in the flow draws its own cart bar instead of Tab Bar · Floating Cart Empty; replaced here. The floating cart variants are set to RTL Off on Arabic screens; an RTL On variant needs confirming.
